en.name: English
en.title: Antigravity Sanction Bypass (Vercel Relay)
en.subtitle: Auto-detects sanctioned countries and routes Gemini traffic via Vercel Edge Relays.
en.notify_saved: ✅ Custom relay saved and activated successfully!
en.guide_step1: 1. Log into your free Vercel account (https://vercel.com)
en.guide_step2:
2. Deploy the included template from terminal:
   cd ~/.gemini/config/plugins/antigravity-sanction-bypass/templates/vercel-relay
   npx vercel --prod --yes
en.guide_step3:
3. Set your new URL in Antigravity:
   agy-relay set https://your-deployment.vercel.app
